import { attachFreeControl } from "@babylonjs/lite";
export function attachFlyControls(camera, canvas, scene) {
  const detach = attachFreeControl(camera, canvas, scene);
  const baseSpeed = camera.speed;
  let shiftHeld = 0;
  const isShift = (e: KeyboardEvent) => e.key === 'Shift' || e.code === 'ShiftLeft' || e.code === 'ShiftRight';
  const onDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => { if (isShift(e)) { shiftHeld++; camera.speed = baseSpeed * 3; } };
  const onUp = (e: KeyboardEvent) => { if (isShift(e)) { shiftHeld = Math.max(0, shiftHeld-1); if (shiftHeld === 0) camera.speed = baseSpeed; } };
  window.addEventListener('keydown', onDown);
  window.addEventListener('keyup', onUp);
  return () => { detach(); window.removeEventListener('keydown', onDown); window.removeEventListener('keyup', onUp); camera.speed = baseSpeed; };
}

import type { FreeCamera, SceneContext } from "@babylonjs/lite";
import { attachConfigurableFreeControl } from "@babylonjs/lite";

export function attachFlyControls(
  camera: FreeCamera,
  canvas: HTMLCanvasElement,
  scene: SceneContext
): () => void {
  return attachConfigurableFreeControl(camera, canvas, scene, {
    upKeys: ["Space", " "],
    downKeys: ["PageDown"],
    fastKeys: ["Shift", "ShiftLeft", "ShiftRight"],
    fastMultiplier: 3,
  });
}
